title: Quarterly roadmap stressor tests and stakeholder heatmap for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Roadmap Q2
description: Objective: Produce a defensible Q2 roadmap for Hosted API + Model Catalog features that ties initiative-level OKRs to scenario-based stress tests (capacity, cost, and quality) and a stakeholder heatmap. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Design and Solutions to: 1) Define 3 prioritized customer scenarios (low-latency conversational, high-throughput embeddings, regulated private deployment) and the acceptance thresholds for latency, P95, cost-per-1M tokens, and quality regressions. 2) Run tabletop ‘stressor tests’ where we model supply-side events (GPU capacity drop, model regression, region outage) and evaluate proposed roadmap mitigations (fallback model lanes, canary windows, reserved burst capacity). 3) Produce a stakeholder heatmap showing who is impacted by each initiative (Sales, Support, Platform, SRE, Compliance) and recommended commitment buffers per initiative. 4) Deliver a digital decision ledger (one-page tradeoffs) that links each roadmap commit to OKR impact, rollback criteria, and deployment policy (canary %, fallback model).
acceptance_criteria: Three customer scenarios documented with measurable thresholds for latency, cost, and quality
At least two stressor test runs documented (capacity shortage and model quality regression) with playbook actions and estimated cost impact
Stakeholder heatmap submitted and validated with leads from Sales, SRE, and Compliance
Decision ledger with explicit rollback criteria and canary window recommendations for each proposed initiative
Roadmap lanes (Must, Should, Nice-to-have) finalized and linked to OKRs with estimated resource commits

2025-03-19: Stressor test 2 (model regression) automated simulation results
